::: {#sol-choose-distribution}

A weekly visit count is a non-negative whole number with no largest value.
The [Poisson distribution](#def-poisson) is a natural first choice for such a count,
because its values are $0, 1, 2, \ldots$.
A [Bernoulli](#def-bernoulli) count has only two values,
and a [Gaussian](#def-normal) count can be negative or fractional,
so neither matches the weekly count.

If the weekly counts vary more than a [Poisson](#def-poisson) count allows,
the [negative binomial distribution](#def-nb) is the next candidate.

:::
